title: Lundahl's Cuban missile crisis briefing for Kennedy

tellings.quote: That was Art Lundal and he got an award from Kennedy for that.

plain: A UFO researcher, Grant Cameron, speaking on podcast host Jesse Michels' show, says that during the 1962 Cuban missile crisis, the standoff over Soviet missiles in Cuba, a man named Arthur Lundahl briefed President John F. Kennedy. Cameron says Lundahl got an award from Kennedy for that work, and he brings it up because Lundahl is a figure in his account of who knew about UFOs inside government.
